name: NMDC Ltd
about: NMDC is engaged in exploration and production of Iron Ore along with Diamond, production and sale of Sponge Iron and generation and sale of Wind Power.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:119)
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1][2][3] NMDC, established in November 1958, is a PSU under the Ministry of Steel (President of India holds 60.79%)[4]. It is India's largest iron ore producer, producing high-grade iron ore with 64% Fe content, and operates with one of the lowest cash costs (C1) in the industry. It also produces diamonds and iron ore pellets, and has entered coal mining.
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 5.19%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 23.6%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 41.3%
cons: Working capital days have increased from 43.7 days to 67.3 days
